mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_key (id, user_id, provider, api_key, base_url, enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{apiKey}, #{baseUrl}, #{enabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_key SET provider = #{provider}, api_key = #{apiKey}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, provider, api_key, base_url, enabled, created_at, updated_at FROM api_key WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
